latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of obscure-package-master

- Provides a method to create deterministic, versioned mirrors of obscure Python packages, with an AST-derived "grep map" of all classes and functions.
- Enables users to efficiently locate and read precise code segments, reducing uncertainty about unfamiliar package APIs.
- Integrates local skill generation and activation for package versions using a script.
- Compatible with multiple AI agent providers, with configurable installation paths via environment variables or config files.
- Designed to prevent API hallucinations by relying solely on source code structure, not LLM interpretations.
